subject: Mutual action plan & SOC 2 contacts — FinServ evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finserv.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & SOC 2 contacts — FinServ evaluation kickoff

Hi Olivia — great to meet you over the demo last week. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep the security and evaluation timeline tight while we run the technical evaluation.

Quick summary and asks:
- Attached is a draft MAP and a spreadsheet we can edit for dates (MAP-FinServ-RDW.pdf; MAP-template.xlsx).
- Can you confirm the primary security/compliance contact at FinServ for evidence uploads (SOC 2 Type II artifacts, system diagrams, data flow docs)?
- If procurement needs a copy of our SOC 2 report or an external evidence checklist, please indicate the preferred delivery mechanism (secure SFTP, SharePoint, or your vendor portal).
- Proposed short timeline: security review window 6/29–7/9, pilot workload 7/12–7/23, final decision by 7/30. If those dates look tight for you, tell us which milestone to move.

Internal roles on our side: Marissa (AM) will run onboarding tasks and pilot coordination; Vivek (Security) will be the evidence intake owner. I will own the MAP and be the primary thread contact.

Links and attachments:
- Evidence intake playbook reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRdw-MAP-FinServ
- Attachments: MAP-FinServ-RDW.pdf, MAP-template.xlsx

Next steps: if you can reply with the security contact and procurement preferences by EOD Tuesday (6/30), we’ll lock the MAP and send the DocuSign for our mutual NDA (if required).

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finserv.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & SOC 2 contacts — FinServ evaluation kickoff

Hi Neha — thanks for the note and the MAP.

Confirming security contact: Michael Reyes (michael.reyes@finserv.com) will be our primary GRC reviewer and handle evidence uploads to our secure portal. Procurement (procurement@finserv.com) is looped for contract timing and standard SOW questions. Legal prefers we route any NDAs to contracts@finserv.com.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
1) For SOC 2, we typically ask for control mappings that map your controls to our control IDs (we have a template; happy to upload it).
2) Evidence intake: can you accept zipped evidence uploads up to 2GB to our portal? If not, SFTP works as fallback.
3) Timeline: 6/29–7/9 for security review is doable but tight — if possible, could you nudge the pilot start to 7/14 to give Michael a couple of buffer days?

We’ll upload the initial SOC 2 checklist and our procurement playbook to the portal once we confirm the evidence owner.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product Operations | FinServ Inc.
olivia@finserv.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@finserv.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finserv.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>, Legal <contracts@finserv.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & SOC 2 contacts — FinServ evaluation kickoff

Thanks Olivia — really helpful. I’ve updated the attached MAP and added an evidence intake checklist for your portal.

Confirmations and asks:
- We can accept uploads via SFTP or your portal; our security team (Vivek) will coordinate the intake process and confirm any size limits. Vivek — can you confirm by EOD whether Redwood can push up to 2GB zipped artifacts to the portal, or whether we should SFTP?
- Timeline tweak accepted: pilot start moved to 7/14, target decision 7/30. I updated the MAP-template.xlsx accordingly (see attachment).
- On SOC 2 control mapping: we’ll fill your template and indicate where audit logs, retention policies, and encryption-at-rest keys are documented. Michael — if you can share your mapping template link, we’ll populate and upload.

Attachments: MAP-FinServ-RDW.pdf, MAP-template.xlsx, evidence-intake-playbook.pdf
Links: DocuSign NDA (if needed) — https://app.docusign.com/rdw/nda/FinServ

Quote from Olivia Barnes <olivia@finserv.com> on 2026-06-25 10:03:00:
> For SOC 2, we typically ask for control mappings that map your controls to our control IDs (we have a template; happy to upload it).

Next steps:
- Michael to share mapping template and portal upload instructions (by 6/26 if possible).
- Vivek to confirm intake mechanism and any upload constraints (by EOD 6/25).
- Marissa will schedule the kickoff runbook and pilot test plan once we have the mapping uploaded.

Thanks all — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a short MAP alignment meeting.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan & SOC 2 contacts — internal: credits for PoC

Quick internal note — forwarding the MAP thread for visibility. Two asks before I schedule the kickoff: 
1) Vivek: can you confirm intake mechanism (portal vs SFTP) and whether we need a short script to pre-package logs and diagrams for FinServ?
2) Marissa/Sean: FinServ is early-stage in procurement; I recommend offering a small evaluation credit for the pilot (equivalent to a single week of dedicated throughput) to help them run load tests. Sean — approve? If yes I’ll include the credit line in the MAP.

Thanks — short replies are fine.

Neha
